fields.description: Le Blanc pairs clean architectural lines and soft interiors with shared rooftop leisure in Dubai Land Residence Complex. Its collection runs from studios to three-bedroom homes, with pools, a clubhouse and outdoor cinema for residents.

overview: 323 homes: 187 studios, 102 one-bedroom, 17 two-bedroom and 17 three-bedroom. Original configuration: two basements, ground, three podiums, seventeen floors and roof.
research.locationNote: The developer identifies Dubai Land Residence Complex, with E66 and E611 access. Its FAQ describes one basement; the original floor plates show two.
research.priceNote: Launch references: studio AED 690,000; one-bedroom AED 1,095,000; two-bedroom AED 1,493,900; three-bedroom AED 1,795,000. Current quotations required.
research.paymentNote: Alternative: 20% booking, 40% construction, 10% completion, 30% over three years at 2.5% quarterly. Original calendar; elapsed dates and current terms require confirmation.
